title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Giving Full Play to the Role of Environmental and Resource Adjudication Functions and Punishing Crimes of Illegal Mining of Mineral Resources in Accordance with Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Fully Leveraging the Functions of Environmental Resources Adjudication to Lawfully Punish Crimes of Illegal Mining

Fa Fa [2022] No. 19

Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has regarded ecological civilization construction as a fundamental plan concerning the sustainable development of the Chinese nation, and has attached great importance to and continuously promoted the work of environmental resources protection. Mineral resources are valuable assets of the country, the material basis for the production and daily life of the people, and an important part of the community of mountains, waters, forests, farmlands, lakes, grasslands, and deserts. Crimes of illegal mining not only damage national mineral resources and their management order, hinder the healthy development of the mining industry, but also easily cause ecological environmental damage and trigger safety accidents. To fully leverage the functions of people's courts in environmental resources adjudication, lawfully punish crimes of illegal mining, and effectively safeguard the security of mineral resources and the ecological environment, this Opinion is formulated in accordance with relevant legal provisions.

I. Raise Political Awareness, Accurately Grasp the Fundamental Requirements of Lawfully Punishing Crimes of Illegal Mining

1. Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization and Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, closely focus on the work of the Party and the state, and build a solid judicial barrier for safeguarding the security of mineral resources and the ecological environment with the strictest system and the most rigorous rule of law. Adhere to a people-centered development philosophy, fully, accurately, and comprehensively implement the new development concept, correctly understand and grasp the dialectical relationship between punishing crimes, protecting ecology, developing the economy, and ensuring people's livelihoods, and fully leverage the guiding role of judicial rules and values to serve high-quality economic and social development.

2. Deeply understand the serious social harm of crimes of illegal mining, accurately grasp the situation and tasks of lawfully combating crimes of illegal mining, and enhance the sense of responsibility and mission. Strictly adjudicate various cases of illegal mining in accordance with the law, closely monitor all links such as illegal mining, transportation, and disposal of stolen goods, adhere to the standard of "all elements, all links, all chains", and ensure the unification of political, legal, social, and ecological effects of judgments.

3. Adhere to the basic principles of the Criminal Law and the Criminal Procedure Law, implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, and pursue the criminal liability of persons who commit illegal mining in accordance with the law. Implement the green principle of the Civil Code and the principles of liability for damage and full compensation, focus on exploring and applying preventive and restorative judicial rules, and lawfully determine the civil liability of persons who commit illegal mining. Support and ensure that administrative authorities lawfully exercise their functions and strictly enforce the law, and effectively pursue the administrative liability of persons who commit illegal mining. Implement the principle of comprehensive accountability, and lawfully and properly coordinate the criminal, civil, and administrative liabilities of persons who commit illegal mining.

4. Highlight the focus of the crackdown and maintain a posture of strict punishment in accordance with the law. Implement the requirements and deployments for normalizing the fight against organized crime and root out local evil forces, continue to strictly punish "sand tycoons", "mine tycoons" and their "protective umbrellas", completely cut off their interest chains and eradicate their breeding grounds. In conjunction with the implementation of laws such as the Environmental Protection Law, the Yangtze River Protection Law, and the Black Soil Protection Law, lawfully strictly punish crimes of illegal mining committed in designated ecological protection red line areas, major river basins, black soil protection areas, as well as in prohibited mining areas or during prohibited mining periods. Based on safeguarding the security and scientific development and utilization of mineral resources, lawfully strictly punish crimes of illegal mining targeting strategic and scarce mineral resources.

II. Correctly Apply the Law, Fully Leverage the Functions of Lawfully Punishing Crimes of Illegal Mining

5. Strictly convict and sentence crimes of illegal mining in accordance with Article 343 of the Criminal Law and the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Illegal Mining and Destructive Mining (hereinafter referred to as the Interpretation). For criminals with deep subjective malice, high personal danger, heinous criminal circumstances, and serious consequences, resolutely impose strict punishment in accordance with the law.

6. Correctly understand and apply Articles 2, Paragraph 1 of Article 4, and Paragraph 1 of Article 5 of the Interpretation, and accurately grasp the prerequisites for criminalizing illegal mining activities. Whether the circumstance of "failing to obtain a mining license" is constituted shall be lawfully determined based on a comprehensive consideration of the specific facts and circumstances of the case.

7. Correctly understand and apply Articles 3, Paragraph 2 of Article 4, and Paragraph 2 of Article 5 of the Interpretation. Where illegal mining activities simultaneously constitute two or more circumstances of "serious circumstances" or "particularly serious circumstances", all circumstances shall be comprehensively considered for precise sentencing. Where illegal sand and gravel mining is carried out within the scope of river management or sea areas, full attention shall be paid to and consideration shall be given to factors such as harm to embankment safety, navigation channel clearance, navigation safety, or damage to shorelines.

8. Fully pay attention to and consider the impact of illegal mining activities on the ecological environment, and strengthen ecological environmental protection. Where there are circumstances of ecological environment damage but the statutory sentencing range is not determined based on the severity of ecological environmental damage, a heavier punishment shall be imposed within the discretion. If the person who committed illegal mining actively restores the ecological environment or compensates for losses, a lighter or mitigated punishment may be imposed in accordance with the law; if the conditions of Article 10 of the Interpretation are met, criminal punishment may be exempted.

9. Correctly understand and apply Article 13 of the Interpretation, and accurately grasp the rules for determining the value of mineral products. Where costs are incurred for processing, storing, or transporting mineral products to obtain illegal benefits, such costs shall generally not be deducted from the amount of proceeds from disposal of stolen goods. If the amount of proceeds from disposal of stolen goods is inconsistent with the value of mineral products assessed or appraised, a reasonable determination shall be made in light of the specific facts and circumstances of the case.

10. Make full and proper use of the fine penalty to increase the cost of illegal mining crimes. The amount of the fine shall be determined by comprehensively considering factors such as the value of the mineral products or the value of damage to mineral resources, the extent of ecological environmental damage, and social impact. Where laws or administrative regulations stipulate standards for administrative fines for similar illegal mining activities, such administrative fine standards may be referred to when determining the fine amount. If the person who committed illegal mining has already paid ecological environmental damage compensation or restoration costs for the same facts, this may be taken into account when determining the fine amount, but shall not be directly offset.

11. Accurately understand and grasp the provisions of Article 72 of the Criminal Law, and correctly apply probation in accordance with the law. For criminals involved in illegal mining who have circumstances such as being "involved in organized crime" or "involved in local evil forces", being "sand tycoons" or "mine tycoons", having previously received criminal punishment for illegal mining or destructive mining, colluding with state functionaries to commit the crime or using illegal means such as bribery to evade supervision, destroying, falsifying, or concealing evidence or transferring property to evade liability, or being punished for multiple crimes, the application of probation shall be strictly controlled. If probation is declared in accordance with the law, the criminal may, based on the circumstances of the crime, be prohibited from engaging in specific activities related to the mining of mineral resources during the probation period.

12. Accurately understand and grasp the legal provisions on joint crimes. Where a person knowingly provides important funds, tools, technology, documents, certificates, procedures or other conveniences or acts as an intermediary contact for illegal mining by others, and based on all evidence in the case can be determined to have formed a conspiracy, such person shall be dealt with as a joint criminal.

13. Correctly understand and apply Article 12 of the Interpretation, and strengthen the disposal of property involved in the case. The illegal gains and proceeds therefrom from crimes of illegal mining, the special tools used for committing crimes of illegal mining, and the personal property of the criminal used for the crime shall be resolutely recovered, ordered to be restitution or confiscated in accordance with the law. For large-scale tools such as machinery, equipment, vehicles, and vessels used in the links of illegal mining, transportation, and disposal of stolen goods, a comprehensive consideration shall be given to the specific facts and circumstances of the case, the attributes and ownership of the tools, and other factors, to lawfully and properly determine whether they are special tools used for committing crimes of illegal mining.

14. Lawfully and properly adjudicate collateral civil public interest litigation for ecological and environmental protection brought by state-prescribed authorities or organizations prescribed by law, and comprehensively consider the criminal liability and civil liability of the person who committed illegal mining. Comprehensive accountability shall be pursued in accordance with the law, while also paying attention to the liability-bearing capacity of the person who committed illegal mining to ensure the effective enforcement of judgments. Depending on the restoration needs of different environmental elements, the application of various restoration liability methods such as compensatory labor, replanting and greening, alternative restoration, as well as enforcement methods such as agency performance and public interest trusts, shall be encouraged. Support all parties in lawfully reaching mediation agreements, and encourage persons who committed illegal mining to proactively and timely assume civil liability.

III. Adopt Multiple Measures, Improve and Perfect the Institutional Mechanisms for Effectively Punishing Crimes of Illegal Mining

15. Improve the "three-in-one" system integrating the criminal, civil, and administrative adjudication functions of environmental resources trials, comprehensively use criminal, civil, and administrative legal means to punish crimes of illegal mining, forming a combined force. Promote the cross-administrative-region centralized jurisdiction of environmental resources cases based on ecosystems such as wetlands, forests, and oceans, or ecological function zones such as national parks and nature reserves, promote the consultation, linkage, and cooperation mode between people's courts, and strive to achieve integrated judicial protection and unified application of law. Comprehensively strengthen the professional capacity building of the team, strive to cultivate expert judges who are proficient in laws and regulations and familiar with knowledge in related fields, and continuously improve the level of environmental resources adjudication capability.

16. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with disciplinary inspection and supervision organs, procuratorial organs, public security organs, and administrative authorities, promote the construction of professional consultation and information sharing channels, establish and improve long-term working mechanisms for the connection between administrative law enforcement and criminal justice in combating illegal mining, and effectively solve problems such as the evaluation and appraisal of professional issues, the custody, transfer, and disposal of objects involved in the case, and the sharing of case information. Lawfully extend the judicial function, actively participate in comprehensive governance work, promptly transfer or report to relevant units clues of illegal and criminal activities and regulatory omissions discovered during trials, and when necessary, issue judicial suggestions, forming an effective joint force for punishment.

17. Respond to the development trend of informatization, relying on artificial intelligence, big data, and blockchain, promote the deep integration of information technology with law enforcement, case handling, investigation, and research, and enhance the convenience, efficiency, and transparency of environmental resources adjudication. Accelerate the construction of a national environmental resources adjudication information platform, build a nationwide "one network" for environmental resources adjudication that connects vertically and horizontally, providing scientific and technological support for achieving timely, precise punishment and prevention of illegal mining crimes.

18. Implement the institutional requirements for people's assessors to participate in the trial of cases of illegal mining with significant social impact and public interest litigation cases, actively leverage the role of professionals in ascertaining professional facts, fully protect the people's right to know, participate, and supervise. Strive to enhance the legal popularization function of institutional mechanisms such as circuit trials and the release of typical cases, deeply carry out legal publicity and case-based legal interpretation work, actively create a social atmosphere for strictly punishing illegal mining crimes in accordance with the law, and guide the people to enhance their legal awareness of environmental resources protection, jointly building a beautiful home with blue skies, green land, and clear water.

July 1, 2022
